onboardingStrategySequence.name: Your progress can fit real life
onboardingStrategySequence.description: Rebuild the source proof pattern as one concise, review-grounded bridge between goal selection and the personalized plan. The screen uses only the selected review, keeps the tone warm and autonomy-supportive, and completes the block without collecting another variable.

instructions.text: Ground the credibility message only in the selected review about achievable progress after a long workday.
Use a concise, autonomy-supportive handoff from the selected goal into the personal plan.
